{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-2jjl7x",
      "toKey": "n-1ll2v21",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The crew was at the gallery with boundary preparation in progress (n-2jjl7x). The shift log explicitly states 'No line opening authorized' and that work was paused due to a service issue under review (n-1ll2v21, n-6s8tyz). This establishes a causal link between their presence/role at the time and the procedural state of no authorization for an intentional interruption.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the crew had not been present or if they were authorized to open a line, would 'No line opening' still hold? Yes; authorization is independent of presence.",
      "competingExplanation": "None identified. The lack of authorization is an administrative fact supported by logs.",
      "evidenceGap": "The gap remains: why the interruption occurred despite no intentional line opening."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1wzbnxb",
      "toKey": "n-6s8tyz",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "RHOB reported an 'air-low' indication and requested attendance (n-1wzbnxb). The shift log does not identify the point at which air supply was interrupted (n-6s8tyz), indicating a gap in temporal resolution between the report and the actual loss event.",
      "status": "partially-supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the interruption point were logged, would it resolve whether the loss was upstream or downstream? Likely yes.",
      "competingExplanation": "The 'air-low' indication may have been a symptom rather than the cause; an unrecorded valve state could be responsible.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record identifies where in the distribution system (source, gallery, receiving header) the pressure dropped."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-13979pa",
      "toKey": "n-6s8tyz",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "No evidence confirms whether crew U-A/U-B saw recent changes or used a different version of the equipment-location sheet (n-13979pa). This uncertainty contributes to not identifying the point of interruption, as misaligned drawings could mask valve states.",
      "status": "partially-supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the crew had used a current drawing, would they have noticed an unrecorded valve state? Possibly.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption could be external (third-party work) rather than internal misconfiguration.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record of which configuration drawing was seen or whether recent changes were briefed."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-128uhnw",
      "toKey": "n-6s8tyz",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "No engineering disposition or temporary instruction was attached for changes to instrument-air service affecting RHOB between 2024-03-01 and May 20, 2024 (n-128uhnw). This absence may have allowed an unrecorded change to persist without detection.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "0ff450fe-49da-4c67-8b42-35449fdad35c#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If a disposition existed, would it have prevented the interruption? Unknown without knowing if the change was hazardous.",
      "competingExplanation": "The service routing may not have changed; pressure loss could be due to equipment failure or external outage.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record of whether any changes occurred during this period."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1st54eg",
      "toKey": "n-6s8tyz",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "No evidence currently establishes whether external factors (third-party work, utility outage) affected the supply (n-1st54eg). This uncertainty contributes to not identifying the point of interruption.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If an external factor caused the loss, would internal records reflect it? Possibly only if monitored upstream.",
      "competingExplanation": "Internal valve state or routing change is more likely given the context of maintenance preparation.",
      "evidenceGap": "No record of third-party work schedules or utility outage notifications."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The causal chain remains incomplete. The interruption occurred during boundary preparation, but no evidence identifies whether it was intentional (no authorization), internal (unrecorded valve state/routing change), external (third-party/utility), or equipment failure. Key gaps include: which configuration drawing the crew used, whether recent changes were briefed, and where in the distribution system the pressure dropped.",
    "evidenceUsed": [
      "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1",
      "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1",
      "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
    ],
    "unknowns": [
      "Point of interruption (source, distribution, or receiving)",
      "Whether crew saw recent changes",
      "External factors affecting supply"
    ],"alternatives":[
      "Unrecorded service-routing change caused pressure loss.",
      "Third-party work interrupted the air header upstream."
    ],
    "confidence": 0.45
  },"evidenceRequests": [
    "Request IA-D03_change_and_work_record_requirements.md to verify if any engineering disposition exists for changes between March and May 2024.",
    "Request structured-incident or conflicts to identify whether external factors (third-party work, utility outage) are documented."
  ]}
